pc_changelog:
v8.5.0 – Search Stability & Notes Auto-Bullet

• Fixed: Critical freeze when switching from Search to Notes or To-Do panel.
• Improved: Auto-bullet creation when opening Notes in bullet mode.
• Improved: Auto-task item creation for empty To-Do days.
• Improved: Robust thumbnail loading with retry fallback.
• Fixed: Filter toggle now properly deactivates on re-click.
• Fixed: Clipboard selection no longer auto-closes during multi-select.
• Improved: Emoji rendering in progress bars.
